name: huly
description: Huly for Claude Code: 200+ MCP tools, a workflow skill, session/PR hooks and /huly commands

huly_email.title: Huly e-mail
huly_email.description: Login e-mail (or use a token instead)

huly_token.title: Huly token
huly_token.description: Alternative to e-mail/password for SSO accounts (npx huly-mcp-selfhost setup)

huly_accounts_url.title: Accounts URL
huly_accounts_url.description: Self-hosted: e.g. https://huly.example.com/_accounts — leave empty for Huly Cloud

huly_front_url.title: Front URL
huly_front_url.description: Self-hosted: e.g. https://huly.example.com — needed to read/write descriptions and files

huly_workspace.title: Workspace
huly_workspace.description: Pin to one workspace (slug or name): tools need no workspace argument, fewer tokens; empty = all

huly_dynamic_toolsets.title: Load toolsets on demand
huly_dynamic_toolsets.description: 1 = start small and load more toolsets when needed (enable_toolsets); empty = off

huly_write_projects.title: Writable projects
huly_write_projects.description: Only allow changes in these project keys, e.g. TSK,WEB; empty = all

huly_file_root.title: Local file folder
huly_file_root.description: Drive uploads/downloads may use local paths inside this folder; empty = off
